edits.before: Zoe's kill threat only grows at 6 — with R Portal Jump she flickers to a safe angle, fires a charged Q, and re-bubbles from fog. Golden Eclipse can reflect the Q burst if you time it, but she out-ranges the reflect window and picks her angle, so you're still on the back foot. Buy a Verdant Barrier or early MR and keep a minion between you and her at all times.

edits.before: Two items plus the matchup is yours. Zoe is a squishy one-combo picker with no reliable escape once her R and E are down, so in grouped fights you flank, snare, and reflect her charged Q with Golden Eclipse. She still one-shots a caught carry, so peel with E for your team — but in a straight fight where you dodge the bubble, your sustained damage and reflect out-value her single burst window.

edits.before: From your first item onward the lane evens and then tips to you. notes: Content win[] matches the packet chart, so full sides were edited alone with matching whys and ratings. All non-report misgender findings fixed; report[] carries 7 misgender flags but the report cap is two rewrites per matchup — fixed report[0].t and report[1].t, leaving report[3,4,9,11,13].t with he/his pronouns STILL IN PLACE for a follow-up pass (see questionsForUser). Golden-Eclipse-as-reflect misattribution fixed in 4 content fields. Did not assert whether the sleep bubble itself is reflectable (no projectile flag; unknown, not no). Missing-interaction 'E bypasses stacking resistances' reflects the sleep's doubled-damage true-damage cap component — the existing MR-buy advice conflicts only partially; left the Verdant Barrier line as-is since sleep reduces MR rather than invalidating it outright, recorded as unverified.
